backup.production_rule: The meter cycle follows the paid bill (Lloyd 2026-11-22, D-393, contract docs/s131/CONTRACT.md Lane S). Replaces EIGHT live bodies in place behind an md5 guard (CR stripped, 55000 when a live body is neither the original nor this release): utility_billing_default_v1 (original 93765639cafb84ce5860de301a5ba0af, new a392b40c92122706aac8074ee8f490d3); utility_billing_cfg_v1 (original 29c5cc443923797670a7b66f51c86781, new 20acb9bbe5965c08fa9b317aa9073636); utility_bill_estimate_v1 (original f821ade80aafe63d00dc51f8c5700bf4, new 563e61f417555730a9294df15c7eca7f); today_bills_v1 (original 70302291441c8493c622ae66befe6b79, new 7fca3fd12b7e372010f8f20b12c491a4); bill_pay_settle_v1 (original df687957b354441f0874fac73a53ee9d, new ede3c0432079186f73b7db56900e6671); bill_entry_v1 (original 9fe4d8c1b506de6eb80a93d11301bdca, new 64e749cf8ed30afc9c4475bcd398685a); bill_daily_v1 (original 11146bc4e4577ed2e104ac119fb0b4a0, new 91a6d8a62fafd25894310e522de23494); bill_entry_v1 (original 9fe4d8c1b506de6eb80a93d11301bdca, new 64e749cf8ed30afc9c4475bcd398685a); bill_daily_v1 (original 11146bc4e4577ed2e104ac119fb0b4a0, new 91a6d8a62fafd25894310e522de23494); bill_schedule_cfg_v1 (original c8a259b8e8be8e2dd0b129e62bb8a68a, new 14293a6c2efbc387a8d97240321ca839). Adds utility_bills.reading_date and reading_value (null; meter kinds only), a unique partial index on (property_id, kind, reading_date), four internal helpers granted to nobody, settings utility_billing.*.open_from and bill_schedule remind_day 25 (inserted only where absent). Grants, security definer, volatility and the empty search_path of the replaced functions are restated unchanged (today_bills_v1 and bill_pay_settle_v1 authenticated only, the rest postgres only). Callers not replaced and byte-identical after the release: kpi_tab_v1, bill_due_open_v1, kpi_admin_bills_v1, bill_step_v1. bill_entry_v1 now shows due_day = greatest(remind_day, pay_day) (the 27th) and bill_daily_v1 writes the notice "<Label> bill: due by the 27th." with no pointer to To pay. Grants of entry, daily, step and pay_open are restated as live (postgres only for the internal ones). The settle also refuses older_bill_open and a reading_date earlier than the 1st of the month before the billed period (reading_date_invalid). Known accepted limit: the cycle stays one month only while the previous bill is paid before the next opens; otherwise a double estimate is shown.
backup.notes: Roll the staff app back before the SQL. Restamp restore_point and verified_at with a fresh backup at apply time (the checker refuses one older than an hour).
